items.docs: Creates a new credential in the Credential Vault. A credential consists of a name, optional description, and one or more typed attributes (such as username and password fields). Once created, credentials must be added to a Locker to be accessible by bots.

Searches for credentials where the authenticated user is the owner or has access through a Locker. Supports filtering, sorting, and pagination. Only credential metadata is returned; attribute values are not included in list responses.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique numeric identifier of the credential

params.name: consumed
params.description: Whether to return attribute values in bot-consumption format

items.docs: Retrieves a specific credential by its numeric ID, including its attributes and current values if the caller has access. The consumed query parameter controls whether to return attribute values intended for bot consumption.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique numeric identifier of the credential

items.docs: Updates an existing credential's name, description, or attributes. The caller must be the credential owner or have admin permissions. All attributes must be included in the request; omitted attributes will be removed.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique numeric identifier of the credential

items.docs: Permanently deletes a credential and all its associated attribute values from the Credential Vault. The credential must first be removed from any Lockers before it can be deleted.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique numeric identifier of the credential

params.name: credentialOwnerId
params.description: Numeric ID of the user who will become the new credential owner

items.docs: Transfers ownership of a credential to another user. The new owner gains full administrative control over the credential including the ability to update, delete, and manage locker assignments.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique numeric identifier of the credential

params.name: credentialAttributeId
params.description: Filter attribute values by this credential attribute ID

params.name: userId
params.description: Filter attribute values scoped to this user ID

params.name: encryptionKey
params.description: Encryption key identifier for decrypting attribute values

items.docs: Retrieves all attribute values for a specific credential. Returns the current values of each attribute defined on the credential. The credentialAttributeId, userId, and encryptionKey query parameters can be used to filter the returned attribute values.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique numeric identifier of the credential

items.docs: Sets or creates new attribute values for a specific credential. Attribute values are the actual secret data (e.g., passwords) stored against credential attribute definitions. Values are encrypted at rest using the Credential Vault key pair.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique numeric identifier of the credential

params.name: attributeValueId
params.description: Unique numeric identifier of the credential attribute value

items.docs: Updates the value of a specific attribute on a credential. Used to rotate passwords, API keys, or other secrets without changing the credential's structure. The new value is encrypted and stored securely.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique numeric identifier of the credential

params.name: attributeValueId
params.description: Unique numeric identifier of the credential attribute value

items.docs: Removes a specific attribute value from a credential. After deletion, the attribute definition remains but the stored value is permanently removed from the Credential Vault.

Creates a new Locker in the Credential Vault. A Locker is a permission-controlled container that groups credentials and controls which roles (consumers) can use the credentials within it during bot execution. Lockers are the primary access control mechanism for the Credential Vault.
Searches for Lockers that the authenticated user has access to. Returns paginated results with locker metadata. Supports filtering by name and other attributes.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique numeric identifier of the locker

items.docs: Retrieves a specific Locker by its numeric ID, including its name, description, and configuration. Does not include the list of contained credentials; use the locker credentials endpoint for that.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique numeric identifier of the locker

items.docs: Updates an existing Locker's name and description. The caller must have Locker owner permissions to update its details.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique numeric identifier of the locker

items.docs: Permanently deletes a Locker. All credential associations within the Locker are removed. The credentials themselves are not deleted; they remain in the Credential Vault but lose Locker-based access.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique numeric identifier of the locker

items.docs: Retrieves the list of credentials contained within a specific Locker. Returns credential metadata and the attributes available for bot consumption via the Locker's consumer roles.

info.name: Update a credential in a locker

params.name: id
params.description: Unique numeric identifier of the locker

items.docs: Updates the association or configuration of a credential within a Locker. Used to modify which credential attributes are exposed to consumer roles through this Locker.

info.name: Remove a credential from a locker

params.name: id
params.description: Unique numeric identifier of the locker

items.docs: Removes a credential from a Locker, revoking consumer role access to that credential through this Locker. The credential itself remains in the Credential Vault.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique numeric identifier of the locker

items.docs: Returns all roles that have consumer access to the credentials in the specified Locker. Consumer roles are used by bots to retrieve credential values during automation execution.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique numeric identifier of the locker

items.docs: Grants a role consumer access to the credentials in the specified Locker. Bots assigned to this role can then retrieve credential values from this Locker during execution.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique numeric identifier of the locker

params.name: roleId
params.description: Numeric ID of the consumer role to remove

items.docs: Revokes a role's consumer access to the credentials in the specified Locker. Bots assigned to this role will no longer be able to retrieve credential values through this Locker.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique numeric identifier of the locker

items.docs: Returns all users who are members of the specified Locker. Members have management access to the Locker and can add or remove credentials and manage consumer role assignments.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique numeric identifier of the locker

params.name: userId
params.description: Unique numeric identifier of the user

items.docs: Adds a user as a Locker member or updates their membership permissions. Locker members can manage the Locker's contents and access control configuration.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique numeric identifier of the locker

params.name: userId
params.description: Unique numeric identifier of the user

items.docs: Removes a user from Locker membership, revoking their ability to manage the Locker's credentials and access control settings.
